subject: maths
question: Ravi's monthly salary is Rs. 16,000. He spends 30% of his salary on rent, 20% of his salary on education. 60% of the remaining amount is invested in mutual funds. Find the amount invested in mutual funds in a month.
solution:
**Given:**

Monthly salary of Ravi = Rs 16,000

Salary spend on rent = 30%

Salary spend on education = 20%

Amount invested in mutual funds = 60% of the remaining amount

**Calculation:**

Salary spent on rent = 30% of 16000

Salary spent on rent = (30)/(100) × 16000</p&
